subject: Request: Senior Authorization for Hosted API onboarding discount (Lifespan Labs)
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@lifespan.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing for onboarding / request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — everyone on our engineering and product teams is impressed with Redwood's latency and burst handling. We're planning to onboard two business-critical services starting Q3 and expect sustained usage of ~1.2B tokens/month by the end of the year.

Before we can lock the pilot PO, procurement needs a committed rate that reflects our volume ramp. Our target is a 30% unit-rate concession for the first 12 months + a 6-month ramp credit to help offset migration costs. I know this is outside standard tiers — can Redwood approve an exceptional concession?

I attached the SOW and our forecast. Would appreciate a short call with your commercial lead this week to align next steps.

Best,
Julia Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lifespan Labs

Attachments: Lifespan_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf), Lifespan_usage_forecast_q3-q4.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Revenue Ops <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Legal <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for onboarding / request

Begins thread for approval — please see request from Lifespan Labs (forecast attached). Short summary: strategic healthtech prospect; expected steady-state ~1.2B tokens/mo; they want 30% off unit rate for 12 months + a 6-month ramp credit. They want committed terms and a PO by end of month.

Why escalation: ask >20% and includes a multi-month credit. Upside: likely a 3-year retention, potential to reference for other health customers, and they want to purchase Dedicated later. Downside: margin impact on hosted API.

Requested action: 1) Ben — advocate on commercial structuring and proposed concession (do you have a companion counter-offer that preserves unit economics?), 2) Markus — quick back-of-envelope on blended ROI/net revenue impact for the first 12 months, 3) Mina — signoff needed for >20% concession, 4) Stephanie — likely legal review on credit terms and SOW.

I'm free for a 15-min sync at 11:30 if helpful.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
(Quoted below)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for onboarding / request

Grace — quick commercial thinking below.

Appreciate the urgency; Lifespan is attractive. If we give a straight 30% off list for 12 months + 6-month credit, economics look rough without commit quid-pro-quo. I propose a structured concession:

- 25% off unit rate for 12 months (above the 20% threshold; still material)
- 3-month 100% onboarding credit (token credit equal to their estimated first 3 months) rather than a time-based cash-credit — avoids cash leakage and encourages usage
- Minimum committed monthly spend (MSP) for 12 months (e.g., $250k/mo) — ensures baseline revenue
- Add 6-month technical enablement credit line (engineer hours) in lieu of further price discount, to reduce migration lift

I think this preserves unit economics while meeting their ask on ramp relief. If Mina approves at senior level, legal to scope SOW language for credits and MSP liability.

Mina / Markus: can you run a quick delta to show NRR outcome vs. baseline and confirm break-even?

—Ben
Head of Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Hosted API pricing for onboarding / request

Thanks for the clear options. I reviewed Ben's proposal and Markus's preliminary numbers (attached summary). High-level: the structured concession hits our objectives — keeps headline >20% concession but with safeguards (MSP + credits vs cash). Given strategic fit and expansion runway, I'm prepared to approve up to 28% blended concession over the first 12 months under the following conditions:

1) Signed 12-month commitment with MSP set at $250k/month (paid monthly), with clawback language for early termination (legal to finalize).
2) Onboarding token credit capped at the forecasted first 3 months (not open-ended).
3) No retroactive adjustments to telemetry/quality SLOs — engineering/ops to accept standard SLO allowances.
4) Finance (Marcus) to confirm revenue recognition path and ensure we aren't materially impairing quarter revenue.

Stephanie — please prepare legal language for the MSP, credit cap, clawback, and warranty limits. Markus — loop in finance to confirm bookkeeping treatment.

If all good, Grace — you can present the conditional approval to Lifespan and ask for PO signature within 7 business days. I want the signed commitment before credits are issued.

Mina Haddad
VP, Revenue (Americas)
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@lifespan.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for onboarding / request

Julia — appreciate the patience. Good news: Redwood's leadership has provided conditional senior authorization. Summary of the approved commercial framework (finals to be reflected in the SOW & order form):

- Blended concession: up to 28% off hosted API unit rates for the first 12 months (effective on signature)
- MSP: $250k/month committed for 12 months (monthly invoicing)
- Onboarding credit: token credit equal to forecasted first 3 months (cap as per attached forecast)
- Technical enablement: up to 120 engineer hours of professional services credited during first 6 months
- Legal: clawback language for early termination and credit reconciliation to be added to SOW

Next steps: 1) Stephanie will send updated SOW and order form with the above terms and clawback language by EOD tomorrow, 2) We require PO/signed order within 7 business days to trigger credits.

If Lifespan can sign inside that window we'll queue capacity and priority onboarding support. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the terms.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
